name: c10-pass11
description: C10: RC8/RC9's P11 work on all three context-size families. 0x234860 (1440p-4K family) is RC11's release program (RC7 guarded lowering, RC8 vector guards and native stream, RC9 point/outer/spatial small sums, RC10 cleanup; frozen source, its stages are not ported). 0x820540 (<= 1080p) and 0x9b99a0 (8K) are that program with their own grid literals (transport) plus RC10 cleanup, instead of RC11's RC7 lowering. The other three slots stay RC7.

history.release: dll/shaders source of the slot (RC7 build_specialized + build_packed --native-dynamic; for 0x234860 also RC8 vector-guards-r1 and guarded-p11-stream-all-r1, RC9 p11-point-small-w4-r1, p11-outer-small-first-r1, p11-spatial-small-w4-r1, RC10 cleanup)
history.transport: dll/port/transport.py: the donor's release program with the target family's grid literals
